per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the dokument.pub FAQ that stated 200 MB per PDF now serves a domain-for-sale page, and no current page of the three sites states a per-file cap

egress.terms: Free public HTTP: every document has a permanent public page and a download endpoint (idoc.pub: /download-file-partner/<slug>?hash=<md5-like>); no auth, no metering, no expiry documented.

tooling: No API. Upload is a browser form behind Cloudflare/nginx bot filtering; download is a plain GET. No rclone backend, no known maintained client.
chaining: Per-record unlimited means the chain is just 'keep uploading': 200 MB/PDF x unlimited PDFs. But every unit needs a form POST, so throughput is bounded by bot defences, not quota.
